name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Wrist Curl
steps: Sit beside a bench, support one forearm palm-up and hold a dumbbell with your hand just beyond the edge.
Let your wrist extend downward slowly so the dumbbell lowers toward the floor.
Curl your hand upward toward your forearm by flexing your wrist while keeping your forearm pressed to the pad.
Lower the dumbbell back under control, and switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Keep your forearm flat against the bench throughout the curl.
Avoid using momentum by pausing briefly at both the stretched and flexed positions.
